method: Manual visual tracing of visible putting-turf and exposed-sand boundaries on exactly projected, north-up RGB panels from authenticated LM RGBI crops. The 0.10 m display pixels resample native 0.16 m source pixels; neither is a positional accuracy certificate. No global registration fit.
